findings.issue: All four resolvers catch every error and render Not found with HTTP 404, silently conflating missing resources with API 500s/timeouts/network failures.
findings.suggestion: Check the error status (HttpClient error event) and only 404 on 404; log or rethrow other failures so they surface as 5xx.

findings.issue: The API cache lives in the per-request injector on the server, so every SSR render refetches the full dataset (18 types, 9 generations, species list, plus up to 100+ move records per Pokémon page).
findings.suggestion: Add a cross-request, shared cache (module-level LRU keyed by URL, or short-TTL entries) — the spec explicitly permits runtime in-memory caching.

findings.issue: Zero unit tests despite vitest/jsdom devDependencies and the configured unit-test builder; pure logic (humanize, latestEnglishFlavor, sortedRows missing-values ordering, cardsFor mapping/dedup) is testable in seconds.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest specs for util.ts and the move-table sorting/filtering before merge.

findings.issue: allowedHosts: ['*'] contradicts current SSR guidance (keep an explicit production allow-list unless a trusted proxy validates headers).
findings.suggestion: Document the proxy assumption in config or derive the list from an env var; at minimum constrain to expected hosts.

findings.issue: Each search keystroke pushes a browser history entry, so one typed query costs many back-button presses.
findings.suggestion: Use { ...queryParamsHandling: 'merge', replaceUrl: true } for search input (keep pushes for pagination/filter selects).

findings.issue: Client-side cache Map is unbounded for the browser session (grows with every visited species/move).
findings.suggestion: Cap entries (simple LRU or size limit) — cheap insurance if the app grows.

findings.issue: The title-set + RESPONSE_INIT 404 boilerplate is duplicated across four resolvers and NotFoundView, so a future change (e.g. status code or title wording) touches five sites.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small notFound(title) helper used by all resolvers and the view.

findings.issue: Dead weight: @angular/forms is a dependency but never imported; app.css is an empty file still referenced by app/src/app/app.ts:7.
findings.suggestion: Drop the unused dependency and the empty styleUrl (and remove vitest/jsdom if no tests will ship).

findings.issue: withHttpTransferCacheOptions({}) and withFetch() are no-ops in v22 (transfer cache and fetch backend are the defaults).
findings.suggestion: Simplify to provideClientHydration() and provideHttpClient(), or delete the empty options call.

findings.issue: Out-of-range ?page=NNN is clamped for display but the URL is not normalized, leaving a URL and view that disagree.
findings.suggestion: Replace the query param (or render-redirect) when page is outside 1..totalPages.

summary: This is a genuinely current-Angular-22 codebase: @Service, signal inputs bound to query params, resolver-based data loading, standard SSR wiring and clean per-route files — I'd have no architectural objections. The merge blockers are the silent all-errors-are-404 resolver handling and the absence of any unit tests for easily testable pure logic. Fix those plus a handful of nits (server-side cache sharing, replaceUrl on search) and it's an easy approve.
